actions.name: reactive
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can take one reaction on every turn in combat.

actions.name: multiattack
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can make seven attacks: six with its [[/item .VzPNwzlwJ7knJ9MC]]{longswords} and one with its [[/item .BoIambnHLbZXr85T]]{tail}.

actions.name: tail
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage extended]]. If the target is Medium or smaller, it is grappled (escape DC 19). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, the marilith can automatically hit the target with its tail, and the marilith can't make tail attacks against other targets.

actions.name: teleport
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

actions.name: parry
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} adds 5 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

actions.name: magic weapons
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: magic resistance
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
